scope: Real-checkpoint Spark mixed-Trellis tile/residency experiments; component diagnostics

spark-tile-640-m16.scope:
Offline Spark tile/residency experiment; never changes the serving policy.

Uses all 384 experts of a checkpoint layer and compares against the production
tile. Graph timings include routing, mixed core and reduction, not transport.
The explicit constructor override changes a static compile key only in this
process; it is not a proposed production policy or a live-count specialization.

two-block-native-640-reference.scope: native AOT versus B12x, six real checkpoint experts; not full-model qualification

decisions: Serving candidate: two blocks/SM only for SM121 TP4 width640 capacity80. Preserve all other exports and automatic policy defaults pending end-to-end evidence.
Width640 capacity80 uses the same K64/N128 tile; one versus two blocks is bitwise identical for all tested outputs, input/route mutations, and graph versus eager checks.
Width640 capacity80: 24 rows/30 experts approximately 619 -> 591 us; 64 rows/30 experts approximately 837 -> 692 us. These are graph-path times, not serving TPS.

Corrected width512 production baseline is K64/N256. Its 64-row comparison is 589 -> 564 us (about 4%), not the 18–19% seen against the initial K64/N128 baseline. Leave it unchanged in the first serving candidate.

Do not change capacity16 tile: its cross-tile gate exceeded relative-max tolerance 0.004, with relative-L2 error about 0.0008. Same-tile residency remained bitwise identical; larger-batch candidate avoids this arithmetic change.

Native C export for width640/capacity80/two blocks passed the six-expert checkpoint oracle and changed-input graph checks. Requesting two blocks with the default width512 K64/N256 tile was correctly rejected by the conservative register guard.
One CPU test passed for explicit residency bounds and compile-key separation. Automatic default configuration is unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic activations/routes over all 384 real checkpoint experts from layer30; not a complete serving qualification or quant top-1 evaluation.
Six alternating-order samples per variant; no formal throttle/clock qualification. One GPU-state snapshot is archived. Relative kernel timings are exploratory.
The early width512 baseline was wrong for production. Corrected results are authoritative; initial raw results remain in the archive for traceability.
Initial probes used an isolated constructor override. The width640 API and corrected width512 results use the explicit committed residency API.
Phase deltas in the early failed cross-tile diagnostic include scratch storage and are not an independent oracle.
